name: Connecticut DEEP Open Space and Watershed Land Acquisition Grant Program

funder.name: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection

summary: Competitive state grants for land trusts, municipalities and water companies in Connecticut to buy land that will be preserved in perpetuity as open space or water supply land, favouring projects that leverage private and municipal funds.

deadline.text: Applications must be submitted by November 6, 2026

status.quote: Through November 6, 2026, the Department is currently accepting applications from municipalities, non-profit land conservation organizations, and water companies to the competitive Open Space and Watershed Land Acquisition Grant Program.

deadline.quote: Applications must be submitted by November 6, 2026, Appraisals must be submitted by December 4, 2026, and Appraisal Reviews must be submitted by January 4, 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Through November 6, 2026, the Department is currently accepting applications from municipalities, non-profit land conservation organizations, and water companies to the competitive Open Space and Watershed Land Acquisition Grant Program.

geography.quote: A permanent conservation easement will be provided to the State of Connecticut, Department of Energy and Environmental Protection

access.quote: Through November 6, 2026, the Department is currently accepting applications from municipalities, non-profit land conservation organizations, and water companies to the competitive Open Space and Watershed Land Acquisition Grant Program.

window.quote: Applications must be submitted by November 6, 2026, Appraisals must be submitted by December 4, 2026, and Appraisal Reviews must be submitted by January 4, 2027.

co_finance_required.quote: Applicants must show a reasonable anticipation that cost-share match funding will be available within one year of the State grant being awarded.
